description: This bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in morphosyntactic probing performance between two multilingual BERT models, mBERT (light blue bars) and XLM-R (dark blue bars), across four different model configurations specified on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled "% point difference," represents the performance difference in percentage points, scaled linearly from -0.2 to 0.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The horizontal axis lists the four configurations: "hidden:[50], linear," "hidden:[], linear," "hidden:[100], ReLU," and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU." Each configuration has two adjacent bars, one for each model, with the mBERT bar consistently appearing to the left of the XLM-R bar. The approximate values are: for "hidden:[50], linear," mBERT is at approximately -0.15 and XLM-R is at approximately -0.08; for "hidden:[], linear," mBERT is at approximately 0.12 and XLM-R is at approximately 0.20; for "hidden:[100], ReLU," mBERT is at approximately -0.12 and XLM-R is at approximately 0.04; and for "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU," mBERT is at approximately -0.18 and XLM-R is at approximately -0.14. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized with special formatting.
